sent_to_model:
Please help me with a email to my brother Denis, I am so angry I cannot write it straight, every time I try it come out half french half insult. He is putting the building of papa on the market behind my back, the building where my bakery is since 31 years. I learn this from a stranger with a camera in my shop at 6 in the morning. Denis live in Calgary, his wife read english better than him so it must be in english. I want he understand I am furious but I also want he stop the sale, I don't want to lose my brother completely. It can be long, there is a lot to say. I put everything below, like it come in my head.

- building 3-storey on rue Saint-Hubert, papa bought it 1979, bakery downstairs, 2 apartments up
- since maman died (Feb 2026) building is half Denis half me, estate settled in August
- I pay rent 2,400$/month to the estate, never late once, I paid the new roof in 2019 myself (38,000$)
- listing with agent at 1,150,000$, I found it online on Centris after
- my offer: buy his half, the caisse pre-approved me for 410,000, I told Denis this in September by phone
- my lease finish 30 April 2027
- Thursday 6am a photographer from the agency come in while I am shaping the baguettes, he say Mr Denis told him I was ok with it. My employee Karine had to calm me
- Denis call me after maman funeral to say 'no rush, we decide together'. Together!!
- when we were kids papa let Denis sleep in the flour sacks room in the back, he loved it
- he did not even call me, he use an agent to tell me, like a coward
- the developer will tear down or make condos and put my rent double, I can't survive it
- he think I am sentimental but it's business too, 6 employees, 31 years of clients
- he take it off the market this week or at least give me first right to buy
- I want answer by phone not by text from his wife
- not sound like I hate him, but he must feel it

(About me: bakery owner, 57, Montreal, Canada. Length: it should come to roughly 800-2,000 words.)

must_cover: Explains the anger at the building being listed without consultation and the stakes for the bakery.
Asks Denis to take it off the market this week or give the writer first right to buy.
Asks Denis to respond personally by phone rather than through his wife.
Makes clear the writer wants to preserve their relationship.

reference.kind: a model-written solution, used only to show the checks can be met
